title: OSCE procedures: asepsis, access and communication
subject: medicine
summary: Identity, consent, allergy, indication and site checks open every procedure, with aseptic non touch protection of key parts and sites. Venepuncture labels at the bedside, cannulation failure escalates early, catheters need indication and confirmed placement, oxygen is prescribed to a target range, and communication stations pace bad news and respect capacity based refusal.

sections.title: Open every procedure
items: Confirm identity, consent, allergy, indication, site, equipment and help, with hand hygiene.
Protect key parts and key sites with aseptic non touch technique in wards as strictly as in theatres.

sections.title: Core procedures
items: Venepuncture: site care, correct bottles and order, sharps safety, labelling at the bedside.
Cannulation: escalate after repeated failure to senior help and protocol alternatives; catheterisation only for indication, with bladder confirmation before balloon inflation and documented drainage.
Oxygen: prescribe target saturation range, device and flow, monitor and review like a medicine. Hand hygiene at the five moments.

sections.title: Communicate and document
items: Bad news: warning, plain words, silence, empathy, checked summary and follow up. Refusal with capacity: explore, inform, respect, document and safety net.
Procedure note: indication, consent, asepsis, findings, specimens, complications, aftercare and escalation triggers.
